description: This file is a shell script that runs a series of tests for the 'git notes' feature, specifically focusing on the 'stripspace' behavior during note addition, appending, editing, and reuse with various options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects a certain command sequence to succeed.
methods.parameters: description of test, command sequence to run

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to be executed after test completion, usually cleanup actions.
methods.parameters: command to execute on test finish

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.
methods.parameters: expected output file, actual output file

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Runs a grep command on output to verify a pattern is present.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
